title.zh: GPT-5.5 API 推理价腰斩，1M 上下文改默认
title.en: GPT-5.5 API inference halved; 1M context becomes default

dek.zh: 价格战打到推理层。媒体和开发者都在算：长文档工作流会不会从 Claude 回流。
dek.en: The price war hit inference. Press and developers are both doing the math: will long-doc workflows flow back from Claude?

synthesis.zh: OpenAI 把长上下文从加价项改成默认能力，同时砍推理单价。表面是促销，实际是在抢文档、代码库和客服日志这类「长输入、短输出」的工作负载。
synthesis.en: OpenAI turned long context from a surcharge into a default, and cut inference unit price. The promo is cover. The target is long-in, short-out work: documents, repos, support logs.

synthesis.zh: 中文报道多在写「降价 50%」，英文报道在写 1M 默认和批处理折扣。事件本身没有分歧，分歧在谁会被抢走：Claude 的长上下文口碑，还是 Gemini 的价格地板。
synthesis.en: Chinese coverage leads with “50% off.” English coverage leads with 1M default and batch discounts. The facts are not in dispute. The fight is over who loses: Claude’s long-context reputation, or Gemini’s price floor.

text.zh: OpenAI 发布博客与价格表，1M 上下文改为 API 默认。
text.en: OpenAI posts the blog and price sheet; 1M context becomes the API default.

text.zh: The Verge 对比例：128k 以上工作负载成本大约腰斩。
text.en: The Verge runs the comparison: workloads over 128k roughly drop by half.

text.zh: 机器之心、量子位同步，标题集中在降价而非上下文。
text.en: Jiqizhixin and QbitAI follow; headlines stay on the cut, not the context window.

text.zh: 开发者对照帖出现：批处理、缓存命中、长文档 RAG 的新账。
text.en: Developer comparison posts appear: batch, cache hits, and the new long-doc RAG bill.

title.zh: Claude 记忆层上线，个人开、企业关
title.en: Claude memory ships: on for consumers, off for work

dek.zh: 跨会话记忆变成产品能力，也变成合规开关。这不是聊天记录，是可检索的用户状态。
dek.en: Cross-session memory is now a product, and a compliance switch. This is not chat history. It is retrievable user state.

synthesis.zh: Anthropic 把「还记得上次」做成一层可开关的记忆，而不是藏在上下文窗口里的小聪明。个人默认开，企业默认关，这条分割线写进了发布说明第一屏。
synthesis.en: Anthropic made “it remembers last time” a switchable layer, not a parlor trick inside the context window. Consumer default on, enterprise default off — the split is on the first screen of the notes.

synthesis.zh: 它会改变周报、客服和顾问类工作流，也会把数据保留从日志问题升级成画像问题。法务要的不是更好的摘要，是关闭、导出、删除三件套。
synthesis.en: It will change weekly notes, support, and advisory workflows. It also upgrades retention from a logging issue to a profiling issue. Counsel does not want a nicer summary. They want off, export, and delete.

text.zh: Anthropic 发布记忆层，企业租户默认关闭。
text.en: Anthropic ships memory; enterprise tenants default off.

text.zh: Wired 把它写成「可检索的用户状态」。
text.en: Wired frames it as retrievable user state.

text.zh: 36氪关注个人版默认开启。
text.en: 36Kr focuses on the consumer default-on.

text.zh: 企业客户开始问导出和删除 API。
text.en: Enterprise customers start asking for export and delete APIs.

title.zh: Kimi 新模型部分开源，LMSYS 前五
title.en: Kimi partially open-sources a new model; LMSYS top five

dek.zh: 中文场的叙事从「能用」变成「可部署」。权重、许可和基准分数被绑在同一条新闻里。
dek.en: The Chinese-language story shifts from “it works” to “it deploys.” Weights, license, and bench scores are one item.

synthesis.zh: 月之暗面放出部分权重，并在 LMSYS 挤进前五。真正被转发的不是聊天截图，是许可条款和私有化部署说明。
synthesis.en: Moonshot releases partial weights and cracks LMSYS top five. What gets forwarded is not chat screenshots. It is the license and the private-deploy note.

synthesis.zh: 「部分开源」三个字会在本周被律师和社区各读一遍。能微调的层、不能商用的工具调用、以及基准是否可复现，会拆成三条后续。
synthesis.en: “Partial open source” will be read twice this week, once by lawyers and once by the community. Which layers fine-tune, which tool-use stays closed, and whether the bench reproduces — those become three follow-ups.

text.zh: Kimi 宣布部分权重与许可。
text.en: Kimi announces partial weights and license.

text.zh: Hugging Face 模型卡上线。
text.en: The Hugging Face model card goes up.

text.zh: LMSYS 排行更新，进入前五。
text.en: LMSYS updates; it enters the top five.

title.zh: Gemini Robotics 2 刷新仓库拣选基准
title.en: Gemini Robotics 2 resets the warehouse-picking bench

dek.zh: DeepMind 把多模态模型重新包装成机器人策略。工业演示多于落地时间表。
dek.en: DeepMind repackages a multimodal model as a robot policy. Industrial demos outrun any shipping calendar.

synthesis.zh: 仓库拣选被写成主指标，视频里的成功率很好看。现场集成、夹具、安全停机这些句子仍在附录。
synthesis.en: Warehouse picking is the headline metric; the video success rate looks clean. Integration, grippers, and safe-stop still live in the appendix.

text.zh: DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 2。
text.en: DeepMind releases Gemini Robotics 2.

text.zh: TechCrunch 强调拣选基准，不给交付日期。
text.en: TechCrunch stresses the picking bench and gives no ship date.

title.zh: Llama 4.1 8B：手机端 30 tok/s
title.en: Llama 4.1 8B: 30 tok/s on phones

dek.zh: Meta 继续压端侧。这条新闻的读者不是研究者，是要做离线助手的应用团队。
dek.en: Meta keeps pushing on-device. The reader is not a researcher. It is the app team that needs an offline assistant.

synthesis.zh: 8B 在旗舰手机上跑到 30 tok/s，足够做输入法、离线翻译和本地摘要。电量和热是下一篇评测，不是今天的新闻。
synthesis.en: 8B hits 30 tok/s on flagship phones — enough for keyboards, offline translate, and local summaries. Battery and heat are the next review, not today’s news.

text.zh: Meta 发布 Llama 4.1 8B 与端侧数字。
text.en: Meta ships Llama 4.1 8B with on-device numbers.

text.zh: 参考实现和量化脚本进 GitHub。
text.en: Reference builds and quant scripts land on GitHub.

title.zh: Rubin 架构细节公布，推理卡仍然缺货
title.en: Rubin architecture details land; inference cards still missing

dek.zh: 规格单很满，交付日历很空。芯片新闻今天仍然是供应新闻。
dek.en: The spec sheet is full. The delivery calendar is empty. Chip news is still supply news.

synthesis.zh: Nvidia 把 Rubin 的互连和推理吞吐写得很细。采购关心的仍是：现有推理卡什么时候能提到货。Bloomberg 和财新都把「缺货」放进标题。
synthesis.en: Nvidia is specific on Rubin interconnect and inference throughput. Buyers still want to know when current inference cards actually arrive. Bloomberg and Caixin both put “shortage” in the headline.

text.zh: Nvidia 放出 Rubin 架构说明。
text.en: Nvidia posts the Rubin architecture note.

text.zh: Bloomberg 把重点放在推理卡交付。
text.en: Bloomberg puts the weight on inference-card delivery.

title.zh: 欧盟 AI Act 通用模型义务进入第二阶段
title.en: EU AI Act GPAI duties enter phase two

dek.zh: 评估报告、系统风险和开源豁免边界被一起拿出来吵。政策开始碰到权重发布节奏。
dek.en: Eval reports, systemic risk, and open-source exemptions are argued as one bundle. Policy is now touching weight-release cadence.

synthesis.zh: 第二阶段不再是原则声明。通用模型提供方要交评估、标系统风险、解释开源豁免。开源实验室会问：权重一公布算不算提供方。
synthesis.en: Phase two is not a principles memo. GPAI providers must file evals, mark systemic risk, and explain open-source exemptions. Open labs will ask whether publishing weights makes them a provider.

text.zh: 欧委会公布第二阶段义务说明。
text.en: The Commission publishes the phase-two duty note.

text.zh: Reuters 聚焦开源豁免边界。
text.en: Reuters focuses on the open-source exemption line.

title.zh: GLM 放出多模态 Agent 基准，中文任务单独切分
title.en: GLM ships a multimodal agent bench with a Chinese split

dek.zh: 又一个基准。有用的部分是中文工具调用被单独打分，不再混在英文套件里。
dek.en: Another bench. The useful part: Chinese tool-use is scored alone, not folded into an English suite.

synthesis.zh: 智谱把视觉操作、浏览器和中文工具调用拆开打分。英文套件里「看起来能用」的模型，在中文任务上会掉一截。这才是今天值得记的点。
synthesis.en: Zhipu splits visual ops, browser use, and Chinese tool-use. Models that “look fine” on English suites drop on the Chinese split. That is the thing to keep.

text.zh: GLM Agent 基准与论文同步放出。
text.en: The GLM agent bench and paper drop together.

text.zh: 中文媒体强调中文任务切分。
text.en: Chinese press highlights the Chinese task split.

title.zh: 扩散语言模型在代码补全追上自回归
title.en: Diffusion LMs catch autoregressive models on code completion

dek.zh: 延迟曲线第一次看起来能进编辑器。
dek.en: The latency curve looks editor-ready for the first time.

synthesis.zh: 非自回归解码在代码补全上追平主流自回归模型，且把尾延迟压下来。还不是训练新闻，是编辑器能不能用的新闻。
synthesis.en: Non-autoregressive decoding ties mainstream AR models on code completion and cuts tail latency. This is not a training story. It is an editor-readiness story.

text.zh: 论文上线，代码补全数字打平。
text.en: The paper lands; code-completion numbers tie.

text.zh: 参考实现出现在 GitHub。
text.en: A reference implementation appears on GitHub.

title.zh: Hugging Face 免费推理额度下调
title.en: Hugging Face cuts the free inference allowance

dek.zh: 免费演示还能做，免费生产不能再装。
dek.en: Free demos still work. Free production does not.

synthesis.zh: 免费推理额度下调后，教学和 demo 还撑得住，把 HF 当生产推理后端的项目要搬家。这是平台定价，不是模型新闻。
synthesis.en: After the cut, teaching and demos still hold. Projects using HF as a production inference backend need to move. This is platform pricing, not a model story.

text.zh: Hugging Face 宣布免费额度调整。
text.en: Hugging Face announces the free-tier change.

title.zh: 通义与三家车厂签座舱模型
title.en: Tongyi signs cockpit-model deals with three automakers

dek.zh: 车舱要的是可关麦、可离线、可追责，不是聊天分数。
dek.en: Cabins want mute, offline, and accountability — not chat scores.

synthesis.zh: 签约新闻的重点不是又一个车载助手，是座舱场景把端侧、语音和责任链条写进了合同附件。
synthesis.en: The news is not another in-car assistant. It is that cockpit scenes wrote on-device, voice, and liability into the contract annex.

text.zh: 36氪先报三家车厂签约。
text.en: 36Kr reports the three automaker deals first.

title.zh: IDE 把本地 8B 补全写成正式设置项
title.en: IDEs promote local 8B completion to a real setting

dek.zh: 补全不再必须出公网。编辑器把「本地模型」和「云端模型」并列。
dek.en: Completion no longer has to leave the building. Editors put local and cloud models side by side.

synthesis.zh: 两家主流 IDE 在设置里给出本地 8B 补全。默认仍是云，但离线包、模型和缓存路径都露出了产品化的边。
synthesis.en: Two mainstream IDEs add local 8B completion in settings. Cloud stays default, but the offline pack, model, and cache path now look like a product.

synthesis.zh: 这会改写代码隐私叙事：不是「我们不训练你的代码」，而是「代码根本没出门」。
synthesis.en: This rewrites the code-privacy line: not “we do not train on your code,” but “the code never left.”

text.zh: 编辑器更新说明出现 Local model 开关。
text.en: Editor notes show a Local model toggle.

text.zh: 开发者开始比本地补全和云端补全的延迟。
text.en: Developers start comparing local vs cloud completion latency.

title.zh: Copilot 多仓库上下文进入预览
title.en: Copilot multi-repo context enters preview

dek.zh: 单文件补全不够了。Agent 要在组织里找接口定义。
dek.en: Single-file completion is not enough. The agent has to find interface defs across the org.

synthesis.zh: 多仓库检索被放进 Copilot 预览。演示是跨服务改接口，风险是权限边界：只读索引还是能开 PR。
synthesis.en: Multi-repo retrieval lands in Copilot preview. The demo is a cross-service interface change. The risk is the permission boundary: read-only index, or it can open PRs.

text.zh: GitHub 宣布多仓库上下文预览。
text.en: GitHub announces multi-repo context preview.

title.zh: 量化方案把 8B 塞进 16GB 笔记本
title.en: Quantization fits 8B into a 16GB laptop

dek.zh: 目标机器不是工作站，是公司标配本。
dek.en: The target machine is not a workstation. It is the company laptop.

synthesis.zh: 新的量化脚本把 8B 的内存占用压到 16GB 机器可跑，并保住补全可用的 perplexity。这是采购新闻：还要不要给每人加内存。
synthesis.en: New quant scripts fit 8B onto 16GB machines without killing completion perplexity. This is a procurement story: do you still upgrade everyone’s RAM?

text.zh: 量化卡片给出 16GB 可运行配置。
text.en: The quant card lists a 16GB runnable config.

title.zh: 隐私团队开始推「代码不离机」开关
title.en: Privacy teams start selling a code-stays-local switch

dek.zh: 这不是模型能力，是采购条款改写成了产品按钮。
dek.en: This is not a model skill. It is a procurement clause turned into a button.

synthesis.zh: 安全团队要的是可审计的本地模式：补全请求不离开网段，日志可关。厂商把这项写成设置页上的一句话。
synthesis.en: Security wants an auditable local mode: completion never leaves the subnet, logs can go off. Vendors put that in one sentence on the settings page.

text.zh: 国内媒体先报「代码不离机」作为卖点。
text.en: Domestic press leads with “code never leaves” as the pitch.

title.zh: 终端 Agent 在无网环境跑测试
title.en: Terminal agents run tests with the network down

dek.zh: 断网不是故障，是测试夹具。
dek.en: No network is not a failure. It is the fixture.

synthesis.zh: 有人把终端 Agent 的工具调用限制在本地 shell 和测试运行器，断网作为 CI 作业。这比聊天演示更接近工程。
synthesis.en: A terminal agent is boxed to local shell and the test runner, with network-off as a CI job. That is closer to engineering than a chat demo.

text.zh: 无网 CI 作业说明出现在仓库 README。
text.en: A network-off CI note appears in a repo README.

title.zh: Anthropic 企业控制台增加数据保留开关
title.en: Anthropic adds retention controls to the enterprise console

dek.zh: 记忆还没成为今日头条时，保留策略先改了。
dek.en: Retention policy moved before memory became the Monday headline.

synthesis.zh: 企业控制台增加保留窗口、可关闭训练和可导出对话。这是给法务看的页面，不是给模型评测看的页面。
synthesis.en: The enterprise console adds a retention window, a training-off switch, and conversation export. This page is for counsel, not for model evals.

text.zh: 控制台更新：保留策略可按工作区设置。
text.en: Console update: retention can be set per workspace.

text.zh: 媒体把它读成记忆功能的前奏。
text.en: Press reads it as a prelude to memory.

title.zh: 跨会话记忆的隐私论文开始集中出现
title.en: Privacy papers on cross-session memory start to cluster

dek.zh: 威胁模型从「模型记住训练数据」改成「产品记住你」。
dek.en: The threat model shifts from “the model memorized training data” to “the product remembers you.”

synthesis.zh: 一批隐私论文把跨会话记忆写成独立攻击面：检索泄漏、画像拼接、删除不彻底。下周一的产品发布会把这些句子变成检查清单。
synthesis.en: A cluster of privacy papers treats cross-session memory as its own surface: retrieval leaks, profile stitching, incomplete delete. Next Monday’s product launch will turn those sentences into a checklist.

text.zh: 三篇相关论文同一早出现在 cs.CR。
text.en: Three related papers drop the same morning on cs.CR.

title.zh: 新基准把幻觉拆成三类错误
title.en: New bench splits hallucinations into three error types

dek.zh: 事实错误、过时、胡编被分开打分，总榜失去意义。
dek.en: Factual errors, stale facts, and fabrications get separate scores. The grand ranking loses meaning.

synthesis.zh: 事实错误、过时、胡编被分开打分，总榜失去意义。
synthesis.en: Factual errors, stale facts, and fabrications get separate scores. The grand ranking loses meaning.

text.zh: 新基准把幻觉拆成三类错误
text.en: New bench splits hallucinations into three error types

title.zh: 开源推理引擎支持前缀缓存共享
title.en: Open inference engines share prefix caches

dek.zh: 同一条系统提示不再被每个请求重算一遍。
dek.en: The same system prompt is no longer recomputed per request.

synthesis.zh: 同一条系统提示不再被每个请求重算一遍。
synthesis.en: The same system prompt is no longer recomputed per request.

text.zh: 开源推理引擎支持前缀缓存共享
text.en: Open inference engines share prefix caches

title.zh: 欧洲实验室公开红队日志格式
title.en: European labs publish a red-team log format

dek.zh: 可交换的攻击轨迹，比又一份原则声明有用。
dek.en: Exchangeable attack traces beat another principles note.

synthesis.zh: 可交换的攻击轨迹，比又一份原则声明有用。
synthesis.en: Exchangeable attack traces beat another principles note.

text.zh: 欧洲实验室公开红队日志格式
text.en: European labs publish a red-team log format

title.zh: 律师把 Apache-2.0 和「可商用」拆开
title.en: Lawyers split Apache-2.0 from “commercial use”

dek.zh: 能跑权重不代表能卖服务。模型卡开始写禁止项。
dek.en: Runnable weights are not a license to sell a service. Model cards grow a prohibitions list.

synthesis.zh: 能跑权重不代表能卖服务。模型卡开始写禁止项。
synthesis.en: Runnable weights are not a license to sell a service. Model cards grow a prohibitions list.

text.zh: 律师把 Apache-2.0 和「可商用」拆开
text.en: Lawyers split Apache-2.0 from “commercial use”

title.zh: 权重发布开始写地域限制
title.en: Weight releases start listing regional limits

dek.zh: 下载按钮旁边出现一张地图，这比许可证更难绕。
dek.en: A map appears next to the download button. That is harder to route around than a license.

synthesis.zh: 下载按钮旁边出现一张地图，这比许可证更难绕。
synthesis.en: A map appears next to the download button. That is harder to route around than a license.

text.zh: 权重发布开始写地域限制
text.en: Weight releases start listing regional limits

title.zh: 社区复现被条款拦在模型卡外
title.en: Replications stall outside the model card

dek.zh: 脚本齐了，法律意见不齐。
dek.en: The scripts are ready. The legal memo is not.

synthesis.zh: 脚本齐了，法律意见不齐。
synthesis.en: The scripts are ready. The legal memo is not.

text.zh: 社区复现被条款拦在模型卡外
text.en: Replications stall outside the model card

title.zh: 批处理折扣写进默认价目表
title.en: Batch discounts enter the default price list

dek.zh: 异步任务终于有了正式价格，而不只是内部优惠。
dek.en: Async jobs finally have a public price, not a private discount.

synthesis.zh: 异步任务终于有了正式价格，而不只是内部优惠。
synthesis.en: Async jobs finally have a public price, not a private discount.

text.zh: 批处理折扣写进默认价目表
text.en: Batch discounts enter the default price list

title.zh: 长上下文缓存命中率成为新 KPI
title.en: Long-context cache hit rate becomes a KPI

dek.zh: 省钱不靠更短的提示，靠提示被重复用。
dek.en: Savings come from reuse, not from shorter prompts.

synthesis.zh: 省钱不靠更短的提示，靠提示被重复用。
synthesis.en: Savings come from reuse, not from shorter prompts.

text.zh: 长上下文缓存命中率成为新 KPI
text.en: Long-context cache hit rate becomes a KPI

title.zh: 中文云厂商跟进夜间闲时价
title.en: Chinese clouds follow with off-peak night rates

dek.zh: 训练可以等夜里，推理不行。价格开始承认这件事。
dek.en: Training can wait for night. Inference cannot. Pricing starts to admit it.

synthesis.zh: 训练可以等夜里，推理不行。价格开始承认这件事。
synthesis.en: Training can wait for night. Inference cannot. Pricing starts to admit it.

text.zh: 中文云厂商跟进夜间闲时价
text.en: Chinese clouds follow with off-peak night rates

title.zh: 办公套件把表格邮件日历串成一条工具链
title.en: Office suites chain sheets, mail, and calendar into one tool path

dek.zh: 演示能改三份文件。审计日志还是空的。
dek.en: The demo can touch three files. The audit log is still empty.
